case_name: Shivani v. Amit Rana — full case name
facts_of_case: Marriage between Shivani and Amit was solemnized on 08.11.2019. Matrimonial discord developed after four years of togetherness. Shivani left her matrimonial home on 14.04.2024.

legal_principles.principle: It is the wife's convenience, which must be looked at in a case where she seeks transfer of the petition.
legal_principles.held: Hon'ble Apex Court has held that it is the wife's convenience, which must be looked at in a case where she seeks transfer of the petition.
cited_cases: Sumita Singh Versus Kumar Sanjay and another, (Year) X SCC Y
Soma Choudhury Versus Gourab Choudhaury, (Year) X SCC Y
Rajani Kishor Pardeshi Versus Kishor Babulal Pardeshi, (Year) X SCC Y

legal_principles.principle: The Court must consider the balance of convenience or inconvenience to the plaintiff or the defendant or witnesses.
legal_principles.held: Courts have laid down certain broad propositions as to what may constitute a ground for transfer, including the balance of convenience or inconvenience to the plaintiff or the defendant or witnesses.
cited_cases: Kulwinder Kaur alias Kulwinder Gurcharan Singh Versus Kandi Friends Education Trust and others, (Year) X SCC Y

outcome.final_order: Petition transferred from Court of Principal Judge, Family Court, Una to the Court of Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Family Court, Palampur, District Kangra.
